description: Track folder for app-remote-agent-chat packets — the Pi Remote mobile PWA that remote-controls the pi coding agent over a Tailscale tailnet (Claude-Code-style pairing). Covers the relay/protocol control plane, auth and tailnet boundary, approval-gated remote mutation, the installable PWA, desktop-parity chat UX (model/effort switching, typed commands, plan mode), the Claude design-system restyle, and platform hardening. Hosts spec folder 001-pi-remote-mobile-agent-like-cc.
